craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 41. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 9. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In word-mantra-syllable in cakra division śakti-principle-going; in words having made mantra-knower in japa and the rest would become fruit-holder.
l4.sanskrit_cite: padamantrākṣare cakre vibhāgaṃ śaktitattvagam padeṣu kṛtvā mantrajño japādau phalabhāgbhavet
